content.text: You’re a creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya. Stripe is unavailable. Gumroad delays payouts. PayPal rejects your country. Your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-broken-here-2|digital]] products—ebooks, courses, templates—sit unsold because the platforms you need don’t serve your region. This guide solves that. You’ll deploy a sovereign digital store using NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-2|COREMERCH guide to payments]], GitHub Pages, and Cloudflare Workers. No platforms. No subscriptions. Full ownership. By the end, you’ll process [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-9|Crypto Payment]] payments directly, deliver products instantly, and own every piece of your infrastructure.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This stack is built on ownership, not dependency. GitHub Pages hosts your store for free. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic without servers. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a flat 0.5% fee—no KYC, no buyer accounts. USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction. Solana averages fractions of a cent. Your customers pay in 300+ cryptocurrencies. You deliver products via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. No platform controls your payout schedule. No country restriction blocks your access. This is infrastructure sovereignty—you own the stack, not the other way around.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Start with a GitHub account for hosting and version control. Sign up for NOWPayments to generate your API keys. Choose USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees. Set up a Google Drive folder or Cloudflare R2 bucket to store your digital products. If using Supabase, create a free account and configure a table for orders. For backend logic, decide between Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Finally, prepare your product files—ebooks, courses, templates—and write clear product descriptions. This stack requires no coding if you follow the templates, but understanding the flow of data from payment to delivery will make deployment smoother.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Integrate NOWPayments by adding your API key to the backend script. Configure the webhook to fire the moment payment confirms on-chain. For delivery, map each product ID to its file location in Google Drive or R2. When a payment succeeds, the script generates a temporary download link and emails it to the buyer. Use Cloudflare Workers for faster execution or Google Apps Script for simplicity. Test the flow with a small transaction—send USDT on Tron, verify the webhook triggers, and ensure the file delivers. This pipeline is your core commerce engine. Once deployed, it runs without your intervention.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction—ideal for high-volume digital sales.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Share the live URL with your audience. When a customer buys, NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain. The webhook triggers your backend script, which retrieves the product file and sends the download link. Monitor your Supabase or Google Sheets database to confirm the order. For your first sale, use a testnet transaction to ensure every step works. Once live, transactions process automatically. You’ll receive payments directly to your wallet—no intermediaries, no delays. Your store operates 24/7, globally, without platform restrictions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Add more products by updating your database and file storage. Optimize for mobile—most buyers in your region access via smartphone. Use Cloudflare’s edge network to speed up delivery. For higher volume, upgrade to a paid Supabase plan or switch to PostgreSQL. Implement email receipts using SendGrid or SMTP. Track sales in Google Sheets or integrate with a dashboard tool. If you’re converting crypto to local currency, use P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia for instant liquidity. This stack scales with your business—no platform limits, no revenue caps. Own the infrastructure, control the growth.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for digital products, integrate NOWPayments into your store. Set up a payment page, select USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees, and configure the webhook to trigger product delivery. USDT payments confirm in minutes, compared to PayPal’s 2-5 business days. In Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya, convert Bitcoin to local currency using P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. This method bypasses platform restrictions and gives you full control over your payout speed and currency conversion.
NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee is half what platforms charge, with no payout delays.

To deploy this stack faster, download the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and step-by-step guides for every component. Whether you’re selling ebooks in Lagos or courses in Nairobi, this kit eliminates guesswork. Build, deploy, and scale your sovereign store without relying on platforms that don’t serve your region.
Your Deployment Checklist

Sign up for GitHub and NOWPayments. Choose USDT on Tron or Solana for payments. Set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage. Configure Supabase or Google Sheets for order tracking. Write your backend script using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Test the payment-to-delivery flow with a testnet transaction. Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Share your live URL and process your first sale. Monitor transactions in your database. Convert crypto to local currency via P2P exchanges as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I avoid high crypto transaction fees?
Use USDT on Tron or Solana. Tron transactions cost under $0.10, and Solana averages fractions of a cent. NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee—no hidden costs.
Can I convert crypto payments to local currency?
Yes. Use P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin, USDT, or other cryptocurrencies to naira, cedi, or shillings instantly.
What if I don’t know how to code?
The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes templates for every component. Follow the step-by-step guides to deploy without writing code from scratch.
How do I handle customer support for crypto payments?
Provide clear instructions for buying USDT or Solana. Use NOWPayments’ transaction IDs to track payments. Offer P2P exchange recommendations for local currency conversion.
Can I scale this stack for high sales volume?
Yes. Upgrade to a paid Supabase plan, switch to PostgreSQL, and use Cloudflare’s edge network for faster delivery. The infrastructure is designed to grow with your business.
Own your infrastructure. No platform controls your access, payouts, or growth.
